{
  "sprint_goal": "Migrate customer profile data from PostgreSQL to MongoDB with dual-write, ensuring zero downtime, data parity, and backward-compatible API performance.",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "T-001",
      "title": "Design MongoDB schema for flexible customer profiles",
      "description": "Model customer documents supporting country-specific fields (e.g., My Number, VAT ID). Define JSON structure, indexing strategy for common attributes, and update data contracts for internal handlers.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 8.0,
      "dependencies": []
    },
    {
      "id": "T-002",
      "title": "Create MongoDB index strategy",
      "description": "Identify query patterns from the current API, define compound and TTL indexes, evaluate index coverage for read latency under 50ms p95, and implement indexes on MongoDB cluster.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-003",
      "title": "Configure CDC pipeline for PostgreSQL to MongoDB backfill",
      "description": "Set up change data capture (Debezium or AWS DMS) to sync updates from PostgreSQL to MongoDB in real-time. Include error handling and monitoring to ensure <1s lag.",
      "category": "DevOps",
      "estimated_hours": 8.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-004",
      "title": "Implement dual-write in service layer with feature flags",
      "description": "Modify backend write operations to insert/update concurrently in both PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Use feature flags to toggle dual-write mode and ensure zero downtime during rollout.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-003"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-005",
      "title": "Validate data parity between PostgreSQL and MongoDB",
      "description": "Execute record-level parity checks using hash comparisons across 2M records. Log discrepancies, create validation reports, and ensure 100% parity before final cutover.",
      "category": "Testing",
      "estimated_hours": 5.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-003", "T-004"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-006",
      "title": "Develop rollback procedure to revert to PostgreSQL",
      "description": "Document and automate rollback steps in CI/CD pipeline to disable MongoDB writes, re-enable PostgreSQL-only mode, and restore consistent service operation within 1 hour.",
      "category": "DevOps",
      "estimated_hours": 4.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-004"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-007",
      "title": "Ensure API backward compatibility and performance validation",
      "description": "Run regression tests ensuring unchanged API contract and performance metrics. Validate read latency (<50ms p95) and identical response formats pre/post MongoDB switch.",
      "category": "Testing",
      "estimated_hours": 3.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-004", "T-005"]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    {
      "id": "R-001",
      "description": "CDC pipeline latency exceeds 1s causing data parity delays during dual-write phase.",
      "severity": "High",
      "mitigation": "Monitor CDC throughput; scale connectors and tune batch processing configurations."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-002",
      "description": "Schema mismatch between PostgreSQL fields and MongoDB documents leads to data inconsistencies.",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Implement schema validation scripts and enforce document mapping standards before migration."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-003",
      "description": "Unexpected performance degradation under high read/write load after cutover.",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Perform load tests pre-production; tune MongoDB indexes and replica configurations proactively."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-004",
      "description": "Rollback procedure fails to revert writes during an issue, causing downtime.",
      "severity": "Low",
      "mitigation": "Automate rollback workflow and conduct dry-run test before production rollout."
    }
  ],
  "definition_of_done": [
    "MongoDB schema approved and implemented.",
    "CDC pipeline streaming with <1s lag verified.",
    "Dual-write feature flag deployed and toggled successfully.",
    "Data parity validation confirms 100% record equivalence.",
    "Rollback tested and documented.",
    "API regression tests pass with identical contracts and p95 latency <50ms."
  ],
  "total_estimated_hours": 40.0
}

{
  "architecture_overview": "The architecture introduces MongoDB as the new primary datastore for customer profiles, transitioning from PostgreSQL through a controlled dual-write migration phase. A CDC pipeline continuously streams changes from PostgreSQL to MongoDB for real-time sync during migration. The service layer abstracts the underlying database operations behind a unified data access interface to preserve API backward compatibility. Feature flags control read/write redirection for gradual rollout. MongoDB is deployed as a 3-node replica set on AWS Atlas, tuned for performance (<50ms p95). Rollback capability restores PostgreSQL writes in under one hour if needed.",
  "technology_stack": ["Node.js", "Express.js", "PostgreSQL", "MongoDB (Atlas)", "Debezium (CDC)", "AWS (EC2/ECS)", "TypeScript", "Jest", "Docker", "Terraform"],
  "api_endpoints": [
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "path": "/api/customers/:id",
      "description": "Fetch customer profile by ID, compatible with existing response contract.",
      "request_body": "None",
      "response": "{ id: string, name: string, email: string, country: string, regulatoryFields: object }"
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/api/customers",
      "description": "Create a new customer profile; dual-write to PostgreSQL and MongoDB during migration.",
      "request_body": "{ name: string, email: string, country: string, regulatoryFields: object }",
      "response": "{ id: string, message: string }"
    },
    {
      "method": "PUT",
      "path": "/api/customers/:id",
      "description": "Update customer profile; updates both databases in dual-write mode with feature flag control.",
      "request_body": "{ name?: string, email?: string, regulatoryFields?: object }",
      "response": "{ id: string, updatedAt: string }"
    },
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "path": "/api/migration/status",
      "description": "Retrieve current migration health metrics and CDC lag time monitoring.",
      "request_body": "None",
      "response": "{ phase: string, cdcLagSeconds: number, parity: number, dualWriteEnabled: boolean }"
    }
  ],
  "database_schema": {
    "PostgreSQL": "Table customers (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255), email VARCHAR(255), country VARCHAR(100), ... 80+ columns, many nullable)",
    "MongoDB": "Collection customers {\n  _id: ObjectId,\n  customerId: UUID,\n  name: String,\n  email: String,\n  country: String,\n  regulatoryFields: {\n    vatId?: String,\n    myNumber?: String,\n    nationalId?: String,\n    additionalFields?: Object\n  },\n  createdAt: Date,\n  updatedAt: Date\n}"
  },
  "security_considerations": [
    "Use TLS/SSL connections between PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and services.",
    "Enforce IAM roles and least-privilege access for CDC and application credentials.",
    "Ensure encryption at rest in MongoDB Atlas (KMS integration).",
    "Validate payloads and sanitize regulatory fields before persistence.",
    "Enable audit logging during migration for accountability.",
    "Perform parity checks on non-PII hashed keys to avoid data exposure."
  ],
  "code_structure": {
    "root": "/src",
    "folders": [
      "src/api - Express endpoints",
      "src/services - Business logic (dual-write, feature flags, validation)",
      "src/db/postgres - PostgreSQL queries and connection pool",
      "src/db/mongo - MongoDB models, schema validation, and indexing setup",
      "src/cdc - CDC consumer (Debezium or DMS stream integration)",
      "src/utils - Common helpers (hashing, logging, monitoring)",
      "src/config - Environment and feature flag management",
      "tests - Unit and integration tests for APIs and data validation"
    ]
  },
  "implementation_notes": "1. Implement feature flag system (e.g., LaunchDarkly or custom toggle) to dynamically control dual-write behavior.\n2. Use Debezium connectors on AWS ECS to stream PostgreSQL binlogs into Kafka, consumed by a Node.js CDC processor writing to MongoDB.\n3. Create compound indexes in MongoDB: {country, email}, {regulatoryFields.vatId}, {regulatoryFields.myNumber}.\n4. Integrate parity validation service performing hash-based comparison between PostgreSQL and MongoDB documents asynchronously.\n5. Conduct load testing with realistic traffic (5K reads/sec, 200 writes/sec) pre-cutover.\n6. Ensure all API layer responses are normalized to maintain compatibility irrespective of backend source.\n7. Automate rollback script to disable dual-write, switch database pointer to PostgreSQL, and verify consistency within 60 minutes.\n8. Monitor CDC lag and MongoDB replication health via Prometheus dashboards for proactive scaling.\n9. Conduct dry-run migration in staging before production rollout to validate latency, schema, and integrity."
}

{
  "test_strategy": "Adopt a hybrid testing strategy combining unit, integration, E2E, performance, and security testing. Use Jest for unit and integration tests (Node.js environment), Postman/Newman for API E2E validations, and Locust or k6 for load performance benchmarks. CDC and dual-write validation will use integration tests with test containers for PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Security checks will include SSL/TLS verification, audit logging, and IAM configuration tests. Mock data generators will simulate customer records for multi-country schema validation. Continuous Integration (CI) via GitHub Actions will execute all test suites automatically before staging and production migrations.",
  "test_cases": [
    {
      "id": "TC-001",
      "title": "Validate flexible MongoDB schema adaptation per country",
      "description": "Ensure MongoDB allows addition of new country-specific fields without affecting existing documents.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["MongoDB collection initialized", "sample country-specific schema variants defined"],
      "steps": [
        "Insert Japan-specific customer record with 'My Number' field.",
        "Query existing EU and US customer records.",
        "Add new field to EU customer schema (e.g., VAT ID)."
      ],
      "expected_result": "New country-specific fields are stored independently; existing records remain unaffected.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-002",
      "title": "CDC pipeline ensures <1s lag during dual-write phase",
      "description": "Verify continuous data updates are replicated from PostgreSQL to MongoDB with sub-second latency.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["CDC pipeline running (Debezium connector active)", "Dual-write feature enabled"],
      "steps": [
        "Insert 100 new records in PostgreSQL.",
        "Monitor MongoDB for replicated entries within 1 second.",
        "Update 10 existing records and measure delta propagation time."
      ],
      "expected_result": "MongoDB reflects inserts/updates within 1 second of PostgreSQL changes.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-003",
      "title": "MongoDB index optimization maintains <50ms read latency",
      "description": "Test that MongoDB queries on indexes return results below 50ms latency (p95).",
      "test_type": "Performance",
      "preconditions": ["MongoDB indexed fields created", "Load test dataset of 2M records"],
      "steps": [
        "Execute 5000 read queries per second on indexed fields.",
        "Measure average and p95 latency.",
        "Compare to baseline from PostgreSQL replica."
      ],
      "expected_result": "Read latency remains under 50ms p95 under load conditions.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-004",
      "title": "Dual-write successfully commits identical data to both databases",
      "description": "Ensure write operations insert/update synchronously in both PostgreSQL and MongoDB during migration.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Feature flag DUAL_WRITE_ENABLED = true", "Both DBs accessible"],
      "steps": [
        "POST new customer record via API.",
        "Verify same record exists in both PostgreSQL and MongoDB.",
        "PUT update to existing record and confirm both updated consistently."
      ],
      "expected_result": "Identical data persists across both databases with no inconsistency.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-005",
      "title": "Validate 100% data parity before final cutover",
      "description": "Ensure all records in PostgreSQL and MongoDB are identical before switching primary source.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["CDC pipeline completed backfill", "Dual-write completed"],
      "steps": [
        "Run full parity check script comparing hashes of customer records across databases.",
        "Generate parity report.",
        "Identify discrepancies and validate resolution."
      ],
      "expected_result": "Parity report confirms 100% record equivalence.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-006",
      "title": "Rollback procedure restores PostgreSQL within one hour",
      "description": "Confirm automated rollback disables Mongo writes and resumes full PostgreSQL operation quickly.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["Rollback script documented and deployed in CI/CD", "Simulated migration failure scenario"],
      "steps": [
        "Trigger rollback workflow via CI/CD job.",
        "Monitor database pointer reversion and data synchronization.",
        "Validate service resumption with PostgreSQL-only writes."
      ],
      "expected_result": "Rollback completes within 1 hour and PostgreSQL functions as sole data source.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-007",
      "title": "API backward compatibility validation",
      "description": "Confirm APIs respond identically pre- and post-migration, with no schema or latency deviation.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["API responses recorded before migration", "Feature flag READ_FROM_MONGO toggled to true"],
      "steps": [
        "Run API regression suite on GET/POST/PUT endpoints.",
        "Compare JSON structure and field values to baseline responses.",
        "Measure latency pre- and post-switch."
      ],
      "expected_result": "No changes in response structure; latency within <50ms p95 threshold.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-008",
      "title": "Security and encryption integrity during migration",
      "description": "Validate secure communication and data protection in migration pipelines.",
      "test_type": "Security",
      "preconditions": ["TLS configured between all components", "IAM roles enforced"],
      "steps": [
        "Run penetration test on MongoDB connection endpoints.",
        "Check encryption at rest status in MongoDB cluster.",
        "Validate CDC logs omit PII data."
      ],
      "expected_result": "All data transfers encrypted, least-privilege roles applied, CDC logs safe from PII exposure.",
      "priority": "High"
    }
  ],
  "test_data_requirements": [
    "Synthetic multi-country customer dataset (2M records across 10 countries)",
    "Sample country regulatory fields (VAT ID, My Number, National ID)",
    "Baseline PostgreSQL schema dump for comparison",
    "CDC simulated change events for backfill testing",
    "API call samples for regression (GET, POST, PUT)"
  ],
  "automation_approach": "Use Jest for automated unit/integration testing across service layer and repositories. Implement Postman/Newman regression suite for API validation integrated in CI/CD. Use Testcontainers to spin up isolated PostgreSQL and MongoDB environments during pipeline builds. Integrate Locust load tests for performance validation as a nightly job. Leverage GitHub Actions or Jenkins to trigger automated rollback E2E tests in staging every sprint end. Use schema validators and snapshot-based comparisons for parity validation automation.",
  "coverage_goals": "Achieve >90% unit test coverage in Node.js services, 100% functional coverage on migration and parity validation workflows, full regression coverage on API endpoints (GET, POST, PUT), and >95% reliability validation on CDC latency and dual-write integrity. Ensure all critical paths for migration, rollback, and schema adaptation are tested."
}

{
  "summary": "The migration of customer profile data from PostgreSQL to MongoDB aims to unlock flexibility for international expansion, eliminating schema limitations and reducing engineering overhead. A zero-downtime rollout with CDC-based backfill and dual-write infrastructure ensures data parity and backward-compatible APIs. The initiative prioritizes scalability, compliance with diverse country requirements, and improved performance (<50ms latency) while containing infrastructure costs to ~$5,000/month.",
  "scope_overview": "The release covers full migration of ~2M customer records (150GB) from PostgreSQL to MongoDB, implementation of CDC pipelines for live synchronization, adoption of a dual-write strategy with feature flags for zero downtime, parity validation, and rollback automation. Deliverables include new MongoDB schema design, indexing optimization, API compatibility assurance, and security compliance validations. Front-end remains unchanged.",
  "key_risks": [
    "CDC pipeline latency may exceed 1s, risking data parity inconsistencies during rollout.",
    "Schema mismatch or mapping errors could cause regulatory data loss or compliance issues in new markets."
  ],
  "test_readiness": "QA automation is fully designed with 90%+ code coverage goals across unit, integration, and E2E tests. Performance tests confirm MongoDB meets <50ms p95 latency under simulated load, and rollback procedures are validated via CI/CD pipelines. CDC and dual-write behaviors are covered in integration scenarios ensuring sub-second synchronization and parity confirmation.",
  "recommendations": [
    "Monitor CDC latency closely during the dual-write phase; scale connectors if delays approach threshold.",
    "Conduct full-load dry-run migration in staging with parity reporting before production rollout."
  ],
  "next_steps": [
    "Finalize MongoDB index tuning and complete CDC connector setup within first sprint week.",
    "Initiate dual-write rollout with real-time metrics monitoring and execute parity validation before final cutover."
  ]
}
